member.name: T:B1SLayer.SLCachingAccessTokenSource
member.summary: A thread-safe that caches the token obtained from a delegate and renews it shortly before it expires, with concurrent callers sharing a single acquisition (single-flight).

remarks.para:
and
return instances of this class. Create one directly to cache tokens from an application's own OIDC library. Create one instance per user, as an instance holds a single token.

The acquisition isn't tied to any one caller, whose cancellation only stops that caller from waiting. It is limited to 100 seconds, after which it no longer holds up the next one, even when its delegate ignores the token and keeps running. When it fails, every caller waiting for it gets the failure, and the next call tries again.

An early renewal runs in the background while callers keep getting the current token, so an unresponsive server doesn't delay them. When it fails, it is tried again no sooner than 10 seconds later, until the token expires.

A token acquired by this source and rejected within 30 seconds isn't replaced: it is returned again, so the rejection surfaces instead of spending a token request on each failed request when the cause is not the token, such as a missing audience.
